prompts.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Edit target: the user's selected Electrify "Connected landscape" illustration.
Task: adapt the approved illustration into a wide 2.14:1 Steam header background, about 2140x1000 pixels. Preserve the selected visual identity and contents faithfully: a prominent electric-blue transmission pylon, simple white wind turbine, small ivory/navy town with restrained amber square windows, compact power station with dome/two chimneys, a three-opening hydro dam and blue river, four-cell dark solar array, and bold blue grid connections with large round junctions. Use the exact reference's flat navy/electric-blue/ivory poster style, broad diagonal land bands and sparse detail.
Keep all important scenery inside the CENTRAL 78% of the wide canvas, with the entire blue pylon near the right side of that central region, comfortable top/bottom margins around its tip and feet, and the dam fully inside on the left. Solar array fully inside lower foreground. The main capsule will crop about 9% from EACH SIDE, so critical content must not be near either outer edge. Preserve upper-left/upper-middle dark negative space for the original wordmark, which is added separately. Do not add or redesign the logo.
The requested change is reframing the selected composition for a wider canvas. Preserve its actual subjects, relative scale, shape language and connected-grid story. Do not replace it with generic chart imagery, silhouettes on a sweeping curve, a realistic city, extra buildings, mountains or forests. No new decorative objects. Flat navy #102031, electric blue #0084F8, warm ivory and tiny amber windows. Crisp graphic forms, restrained outline detail.
No text, logo, title, numbers, labels, watermark or badges. No gradients, neon glows or photorealism. Full-bleed panoramic landscape, aspect ratio 2.14:1.
